_about: Session budgets (docs/ENGINE-V2.md, section 5). Config, not judgment, so a spec never signs them. Provisional until Phase 0 calibrates them against scripts/baseline.py. max_tokens counts Claude model tokens (tokens_in plus tokens_out in local/engine/sessions.jsonl); max_engine_minutes is wall-clock engine time, which for production is Codex minutes on the pinned model. null means the budget comes from the task card (max_minutes, max_calls). engine/session.py load_budgets() is the enforcement.

scheduled.note: The CLI at 06:15, Monday 08:00 and the 05:10 UTC dispatch. No pack, no model.

orchestrator.note: A fresh Claude session from a pack of 36 KB or less. Ends at a gate.

production.note: Codex in the main checkout with --require-existing-history: 30 Codex minutes. Claude makes the connector calls (Canva, Higgsfield, product fetches), so it has a Claude-token budget: 60000 is provisional until Phase 0 measures it. Ends when the pack is ready.

review.note: A fresh Claude session that made nothing, reading lenses, the COPY.md rubric and a contact sheet. Ends at 38 of 48 or more, Ethics and Action both at 4, two alternatives.

build.note: Per card: the task card's max_minutes and max_calls. Ends when acceptance exits 0.
